name: Old City Hall
text: 110 The Queen's Walk, formerly City Hall, is a building in Bermondsey, London, that served as the headquarters of the Greater London Authority (GLA) between July 2002 and December 2021. It is undergoing partial demolition and reconstruction. Originally, designed by Norman Foster, it is located on the south bank of the River Thames near Tower Bridge.

depictions.name: Old City
depictions.text: The Old City was the ancient city that laid the foundation of the city of Uldar, Gullnámar, in Svartálfaheimr. During the warlord Surtr's invasion, his Muspel force took control of the district and forced their dwarven captives to search for any valuables under Surtr's son Glöð's supervision.
